sys_ui_page.html:
Xurrent IMR — Contact Support

Need help with the Xurrent IMR integration for ServiceNow? Use the channels below.

Support coverage

  • Hours: 24x7 for production-impacting issues; business hours for general requests.
  • Scope: installation, configuration, OAuth setup, incident/work note synchronization, and connectivity to the Xurrent IMR service.

How to reach us

  • Support portal: https://support.xurrent.com
  • Email: support@xurrent.com

Before contacting support

Please have ready: your ServiceNow instance name, the value of x_xurre_imr.service_now_instance_identifier, whether x_xurre_imr.integration_enabled is true, and any relevant entries from System Log > Outbound HTTP Requests.
